def VTask.bitCasesOn {motive : ℕ → Sort u} (n : ℕ) (bit : (b : Bool) → (m : ℕ) → motive (Nat.bit b m)) : motive n :=
match n with
| 0 => bit false 0
| succ n' =>
  match Nat.binary n' with
  | Nat.binaryZero => bit true 0
  | Nat.binaryOne m => bit false m
